title: Lightdash CLI via mise
description: Pins the Lightdash CLI 2.361.0 in mise.toml as the self-contained release binary, verified against its GitHub attestations, rather than the npm package that mise's embedded installer rejects; Lightdash publishes that binary for macOS and Linux x64 only. Base's lightdash-skills runs the same version, so bump both, then resync that patch in base.
